CARGO_BUILD_JOBS.note: First compile completed the library; binary compile deliberately restarted with four jobs using cached same-source library. No optimization, feature, or codegen flag changes. Prior attempt and restart reason preserved in build-library-one-job/.

primary_instrumentation: observability feature + runtime metrics; 1 Hz scrape; request trace disabled
object_store: isolated compose Redis/RustFS on same host; image IDs in harness/compose.yml
drain: legacy .stats extended debt gauges all zero and stable object PUT count/bytes for 3 samples, 0.5 s apart; 180 s timeout; include fio close wall time
perf: perf record -F 499 -g --call-graph dwarf,8192 -e cpu-clock -z -p DAEMON -- sleep WINDOW; measurement interval only; software event because no virtual PMU
statistic: paired on-minus-off differences; mean +/- t(0.975,n-1)*SD/sqrt(n); n>=3; report all rounds and median p99
limits: buffered libaio may achieve lower depth than requested; retain iodepth distribution
fio latency includes client/kernel queues; FUSE metric histograms are separate
CPU profiles describe on-CPU cost, not off-CPU waiting
no global drop_caches; every arm begins with its own full prefill
raw numbers remain provisional until the complete same-iteration workspace and overlay CI gates pass
compose container runner broad guards are separate from the paired host FUSE campaign

amendments.change: remove unrelated packed fields inherited from historical protocol; replace slow S3 per-object cleanup with stopped task-backend directory reset
amendments.reason: all main/off/on arms receive the same clean backend state without spending the test budget deleting thousands of disposable small objects via HTTP

baseline: same final release binary, coalesce off
schedule: randwrite, seqwrite, randrw (v1 order): 2 off/on warmup pairs + 3 off/on measurement pairs each; direct: 1 off/on pair each
round_reset: after confirming no task FUSE mount remains, stop task RustFS, remove only its disposable objects bind directory, recreate with original ownership, restart, clear task Redis DB 0 and recreate task bucket; fresh mount and 512 MiB/file incompressible prefill with fsync and strict drain before every arm
artifact_cleanup: delete task-owned object payloads after completed unmount; preserve all measurement artifacts
supported_volume_scope: flat with Redis and upload_before_commit; no native-v2 or packed performance claim
direct_guard: one off/on pair per workload with fio direct=1; separate guard rows, excluded from primary confidence intervals
upload_concurrency: existing foreground semaphore 192 and FileWriter local limit; groups acquire one permit per participating file in stable order
put_normalization: physical PUT count including drain / logical fio write GiB, excluding prefills; mean PUT = physical bytes / physical count
broad_harness_amendments: Record actual unmount commands/results and post-runner mount/process tables; workload script unchanged.
Bind byte-identical Python helper copies with executable mode, matching image installation; repository files are mode 644.
additional_correctness: After the unchanged v1 paired/broad campaign, repeat the same fsync/close -> SIGKILL -> 8192-block SHA-256 checks with buffered FUSE, off and on, using verify-modes.py from the prior review.
